{{Quote|Words have power. Proof is in the Sith scrolls I acquired. When read, they release malevolence as a safeguard against those who would unlock their secrets. Better to leave hundreds blinded with a binding curse than surrender power to a single fool.|[[Sorzus Syn]], Lord of the Sith|<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Sith scrolls''' or '''tomes''' were ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] writings, scribed by the very hand of a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].

==History==
The ancient [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Andeddu]] was the author of many [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] scrolls which he hoarded in his [[Andeddu's Keep|Fortress]] on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]].<ref name="Legacy 27" />

After the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the majority of Sith scrolls, among other artifacts, were destroyed by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Like [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulets]], scrolls were deemed dangerous, since they propagated Sith teachings and often possessed the ability to drive their reader insane.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref><ref name="Jedi Academy Training Manual">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>

In [[3997 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> wayward [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] found ancient Sith scrolls<ref name="dlots2" /> that were written by [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]<ref name="Naga" /> when he raided the [[Tomb of Freedon Nadd]]. [[Freedon Nadd]] gave the scrolls to Kun after he opened the sarcophagus.<ref name="dlots2" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], two of his [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Hands]], [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren]] and [[Cronal|Blackhole]], obtained and studied ancient Sith scrolls that contained knowledge of the forgotten art of ''[[mechu-deru]]''.<ref name="end" />
